evidence_kind: Synthetic cash-unit regression and local affected-domain verification; not market or account evidence
source_hash_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF; preserve BOM

reproduction.before: allowed=true; daily_loss=0; session_loss=0 despite unrelated cash denominations
reproduction.before_test: The first mixed-quote regression failed before the production repair

contract.native_history: Any native entry cash receipt in the paired open/closed snapshot keeps quote qualification active
contract.flat_inventory: Same-quote realized cash needs instrument/product context but no current mark
contract.open_inventory: Existing positive finite mark and exact open instrument/product requirements remain
contract.product_context: spot or futures; this does not qualify native Futures fees or cash
contract.quote_context: Supported quote and all closed-trade symbols share that quote; no guessed FX
contract.unknown_valuation: Blocks new exposure without forcing an uncertain close; zero guard fields are uncalculated placeholders
contract.known_loss: Existing daily/session loss thresholds still apply to qualified same-quote cash
contract.restart: Boundary is derived from persisted native trade history, not an ephemeral open-position flag
contract.legacy_only: Unchanged legacy semantics, not newly cash-qualified
contract.owned_reduction: No close, order transmission, account or credential implementation changed
